criteria.description: Leads with the user problem and some evidence/justification rather than opening with the solution.
Names the specific target user and the job-to-be-done, not just 'users'.
Defines measurable success metric(s) with a target, not 'users will like it'.
Requirements are prioritized (MoSCoW or P0/P1/P2) and expressed as testable user stories with acceptance criteria.
Acceptance criteria or requirements cover edge/error cases, not only the happy path.
Surfaces risks/dependencies/open questions and a rollout or milestone plan.
